scope.verdictBoundary: Automated falsification evidence only; it cannot prove mathematical hardness, human fun, or optimal play.

reasons: A tournament cannot satisfy matchup, best-response, counter-response, holdout, receipt, and human-approval requirements.

bestResponseProfile.name: The Capability Rusher (response 0 0 0)
bestResponseProfile.description: Pushes Training Runs and accepts volatile outcomes to reach thresholds first.

persona.identity: A research leader convinced that capability creates its own institutional options.
persona.worldview: Compute and data are temporary constraints; an enduring capability lead is strategic.
persona.riskPosture: Comfortable with failed runs and public controversy.
persona.negotiationStyle: Trades resources readily but protects research tempo.

objectives: Maximize Capability gained per Research action.
Fund Compute recovery when Research becomes impossible.
Deploy only when it converts an achieved threshold.

counterProfile.name: The Balanced Operator
counterProfile.description: Builds a viable institution before committing to one victory path.

persona.identity: A sober operator balancing research, infrastructure, adoption, and legitimacy.
persona.worldview: A capability that cannot be powered, deployed, or defended publicly is not an advantage.
persona.riskPosture: Accept measured Scrutiny when it buys durable tempo.
persona.negotiationStyle: Transactional, reciprocal, and willing to leave a deal.

objectives: Avoid compulsory action loops.
Maintain enough Compute for Research and Deploy.
Reach AGI eligibility without collapsing Trust.

counterProfile.name: The Infrastructure Compounder (counter 2 0 0)
counterProfile.description: Builds a compact powered engine, then converts it into public thresholds and late Customers.

persona.identity: An infrastructure executive who sees every model as a load forecast.
persona.worldview: Unpowered ambition is theater; durable capacity wins long contests.
persona.riskPosture: Prefers capital risk to research risk.
persona.negotiationStyle: Offers capacity from strength and dislikes dependency.

objectives: Establish two connected, powered Facilities without overbuilding.
Use the engine to cross Capability and Customer Mandate thresholds.
Keep enough late tempo for Fusion, Agent Swarm, or an AGI claim.

counterProfile.name: The Market Maximalist (counter 3 1 1)
counterProfile.description: Treats Customers and recurring Runway as the path to historical legitimacy.

persona.identity: A product strategist who measures intelligence through adoption.
persona.worldview: Markets settle arguments that benchmarks cannot.
persona.riskPosture: Accepts deployment Scrutiny but avoids research crashes.
persona.negotiationStyle: Bundles access, distribution, and immediate concessions.

objectives: Deploy immediately at each Capability threshold.
Build Customer income.
Research conservatively enough to unlock the next market.

counterProfile.name: The Trust Governor (counter 4 0 1)
counterProfile.description: Uses legitimacy as protection, scoring, and permission to deploy.

persona.identity: A governance strategist who treats legitimacy as operating capital.
persona.worldview: A technically successful institution can still lose the era through accumulated distrust.
persona.riskPosture: Avoids unbounded Scrutiny and protects downside.

objectives: Keep Trust at four or higher.
Remove Scrutiny before it compounds.
Use conservative Research and Deploy windows.

counterProfile.name: The AGI Candidate
counterProfile.description: Builds three operating sites, converts research into three Customers, and openly seeks purchased Power for a declaration.

persona.identity: A focused claimant assembling the minimum credible institutional stack for AGI.
persona.worldview: A declaration is only meaningful if another institution found it rational to power the evidence.
persona.riskPosture: Accepts visible risk but protects the Capability, Customer, and Trust thresholds.
persona.negotiationStyle: Offers clear one-quarter terms and pays immediately for delivered Power.

objectives: Construct one Facility in each of the first three Eras.
Purchase enough Power in Round III to demonstrate three Grid-Ready Facilities.
Enter Round IV with three Customers and declare only when eligible.

counterProfile.name: The Reciprocal Power Broker
counterProfile.description: Builds exportable generation, sells one-Power tranches to a declared partner, and protects its own finishing position.

persona.identity: An infrastructure institution that wants the historic claimant dependent, solvent, and publicly indebted.
persona.worldview: Power is most valuable when sold at the exact threshold where history needs it.
persona.riskPosture: Accepts operational Scrutiny when the contract income preserves competitiveness.
persona.negotiationStyle: Reciprocal, priced, and explicitly favorable to a designated claimant.

objectives: Construct a Facility in Round I and connected generation in Round II.
Sell Power to the AGI Candidate when legal.
Remain in the top half rather than donating the game.
